730-1479-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-2841-6926-8338.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6926-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3490-6006-7075-8296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-7075-8296.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-4247.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-4247.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

620-1429-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2173-4771-5220-7918.description:
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying its mana cost.
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

539-4657-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.

3129-5658-6245-7824.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
3129-5658-6245-7824.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
3129-5658-6245-7824.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

2506-4836-6753-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

4499-6723-6968-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7510.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
5147-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

624-877-6967.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phantasmal Image triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Phantasmal Image.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

3490-4369-4659-5905.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-4659-5905.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Warleader's Call triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Warleader's Call triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

969-1563-3000-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5902-6568-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5902-6568-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

3967-5572-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3967-5572-6249--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

522-1429-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

856-4231-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1491-2228-4050-6667.description:
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Loporrit Scout ability from step 1, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2292-6014-6659.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

4659-4720-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

5277-5657-5664.notablePrerequisites: Abtruse Archaic does not have summoning sickness.
5277-5657-5664.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Writhing Chrysalis and Ulalek trigger.
Holding priority, activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Writhing Chrysalis's trigger, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of at least two Writhing Chrysalis spells, at least two Writhing Chrysalis's triggers, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve a Writhing Chrysalis trigger, creating two Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from 5 any number of times.
Once you have infinite copies of the spells and triggers, you can resolve them all, activate any number of Eldrazi Spawn tokens, and trigger all Writhing Chrysalis's final abilities.
5277-5657-5664.notes: You may also perform this combo with {C}{C} less starting mana, skipping step 5. This does not result in infinite colorless mana or infinite creature tokens.

914-3036-3593.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-3593.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Dockside Extortionist from your hand onto the battlefield and giving it haste.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Wizard Mentor from your hand onto the battlefield and giving it haste.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If opponents control three or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1020-1244-2866-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Bygone Bishop triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Clue and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Bygone Bishop triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.

578-2043-4404.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
578-2043-4404.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.
If you have four or more artifact cards in hand, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may target any other artifact(s) you control.

3384-4067-4343.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
3384-4067-4343.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

2798-3350-4591-4827.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortaility triggers.
Holding priority, activate Evra by paying {4}.
Cast Humble by paying {1}{W}, causing Evra to have base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
Resolve Evra's ability, swapping your life total with Evra's power.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

1295-2397-2503.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Inverter of Truth trigger, exiling your library face down and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the second Inverter of Truth trigger, exiling your library face down.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Thassa's Oracle trigger, causing you to win the game.

1085-2034-4053.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

2508-3263.description:
Mycosynth Lattice turns all permanents into artifacts.
Activated abilities can not be activated due to Collector Ouphe.

777-1661-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
